verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cloudflare's own globally distributed key-value store (KV) and a separate Queues product. Nothing in the pack says either is Redis-compatible (Redis protocol or API). A proprietary KV store plus a separate queue service is an adjacent capability, not the Redis-compatible store the story asks for.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use a Redis-compatible key-value store for low-latency caching and job queues
